title: Rocket.Chat's POST /api/v1/chat.sendMessage endpoint improperly validates nested message properties, allowing…
description: A vulnerability in Rocket.Chat's POST /api/v1/chat.sendMessage endpoint allows authenticated users with standard privileges to inject arbitrary message metadata. This improper validation of nested message properties can result in persistent denial of service at the room level, stored HTML/iframe injection, unauthorized changes to other users' private starred messages, permission bypass, spoofing of pinned message attribution, forged edit attribution, and invisible user mentions.
